minimumSourceProvedPureReduction.proposal: Retain one method-local canonical UTF8 byte array at the ORIGINAL byte-budget point. Use its length for the same guard; compute SHA256/hex of those same bytes at the ORIGINAL hash point after all existing intervening guards. A private digest helper may preserve existing SHA256/hex/NoSuchAlgorithmException behavior without changing public hash APIs. No cache/persisted materialization/lock/guard/source/auth/clock/hash tuple change; no moving validation or hashing outside TX.
